hero.headline: Building a B2B pipeline for a 180-year-old heritage jewellery business
hero.intro: With a family legacy spanning **180 years and five generations**, our client has spent more than 35 years specialising in antique jewellery, heirloom collections, professional valuations, and jewellery liquidation. As a government-approved valuer, the business helps families, advisors, and institutions assess valuable assets, document inherited collections, and navigate asset transfers. The objective was to extend its reach beyond traditional networks into **accounting, wealth management, private banking, insurance, and lending**.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Antique jewellery valuation and liquidation are highly specialised services. Unlike conventional jewellery retail, these requirements typically involve inherited assets, collections without formal documentation, estate divisions, and families seeking trusted guidance on high-value possessions.

While credibility was firmly established through generations of industry experience, the challenge was making that specialist expertise visible to advisors and intermediaries outside its existing network.

Each professional group had fundamentally different responsibilities: a **Chartered Accountant** encounters inherited jewellery during estate tax filing; a **Wealth Manager** encounters undocumented jewellery during family estate planning; an **insurance professional** needs specialist assessment for older pieces; a **gold loan lender** requires risk checks on mixed purity items. A generic valuation pitch would have fallen completely flat.

approach.heading: The Approach: Heritage-Led Credibility & Professional Segmentation
approach.intro: Rather than focusing exclusively on jewellery traders and collectors, Myntmore expanded outreach into adjacent professional sectors where jewellery assets naturally form part of broader wealth, tax, or lending workflows:

audiences.title: Chartered Accountants (CAs)
audiences.description: Positioned around formal valuation requirements, documentation of inherited assets, and supporting families through estate settlements.

audiences.title: Wealth Managers & Private Bankers
audiences.description: Approached around high-value jewellery holdings frequently left out of estate planning portfolios and wealth transfers.

audiences.title: Insurance Claims Teams
audiences.description: Approached around assessment accuracy for older, antique, or mixed pieces lacking original purchase bills.

audiences.title: Gold Loan Institutions
audiences.description: Approached around valuation accuracy, risk management, and the complexities of assessing mixed-era ornaments.

stages.title: 1. Connection Request
stages.description: Establish relevance through shared context, family business heritage, or specialist credentials.

stages.title: 2. First Follow-Up
stages.description: Introduce a practical situation where valuation, liquidation, or documentation expertise assists their clients.

stages.title: 3. Relationship Nurture
stages.description: Keep channels open with direct contact details and scheduling options without repeating a hard pitch.

results.heading: Outreach Results by Segment
results.intro: Across the broader campaign, Myntmore sent **2,298 connection requests**, generating **897 accepted connections, 392 responses, 68 hot leads, and 9 scheduled meetings**. The 5 detailed ICP segments below represent 1,197 targeted profiles:

segments.name: Chartered Accountants
segments.notes: Highest response rate and hot-lead volume; 86 responses and 2 meetings

segments.name: Wealth Managers
segments.notes: Highest acceptance rate, showing strong initial willingness to connect

segments.name: Gold Loans
segments.notes: Strong acceptance rate and 2 scheduled meetings

segments.name: Private Banking
segments.notes: Second-highest hot-lead volume with significant relationship upside

insight.heading: Acceptance vs. Conversion Dynamics
insight.text: The campaign highlighted an important pattern: **Wealth Managers** were the most receptive to connecting (**57.60% acceptance**), but **Chartered Accountants** generated the highest post-connection response (**49.71%**) and lead volume (**9 hot leads, 2 booked meetings**). Meanwhile, **Gold Loan** executives converted with high intent, delivering 2 scheduled meetings from a focused list.

whyItWorked.heading: Why It Worked: Making Heritage Relevant to Modern Financial Services
whyItWorked.intro: A 180-year family legacy establishes instant credibility, but heritage alone does not explain why an accountant, wealth manager, or lender should take time out of their day. The strength of the approach came from translating decades of specialized experience into tangible utility:
points: **Role-Specific Triggers:** Tax advisors heard about documentation; wealth planners heard about overlooked estate components; claims adjusters heard about dispute resolution.

**Pre-Positioning Before Need Arises:** Valuations are milestone-driven events. Establishing trust in advance ensured our client was top-of-mind the moment an estate settlement or liquidation requirement occurred.
**Expanding Beyond Traditional Guilds:** Looking past standard jewellery trade shows directly into advisory professions opened completely uncontested referral pipelines.

items.title: 68 hot leads and 9 meetings booked across non-traditional networks
items.body: Validating that high-end heritage expertise can tap into financial and accounting ecosystems for predictable deal flow.

items.title: Chartered Accountants delivered the deepest engagement
items.body: With a 49.71% response rate and 9 hot leads, CAs proved to be natural referral partners facing frequent client valuation questions.

items.title: Wealth Managers exhibited highest initial curiosity
items.body: A 57.60% acceptance rate demonstrated that wealth professionals readily welcome estate valuation specialists into their networks.

items.title: High acceptance does not equal immediate commercial intent
items.body: Some segments connect easily but require ongoing nurturing; others connect at standard rates but convert immediately into meetings.

items.title: Relevance always beats generic prestige
items.body: Connecting a 180-year legacy to real-world use cases in accounting, estate planning, and lending turned historical credentials into modern business opportunities.
